audit.method: Static audit of the local Bitwig 5.1.7 install and of every crate in the Hikaru OpenLive workspace.

areas.name: Clip Launcher
areas.bitwig_reference: Clip Launcher, scenes, clip slots and launch quantization (Bitwig Studio 5.1.7).

features.name: MIDI note preview inside clip slots
Take-over mode and per-clip launch settings

areas.name: Arranger
areas.bitwig_reference: Arranger timeline, clip editing, loop region and arrangement tools (Bitwig Studio 5.1.7).

features.name: Automation lane display/editing
features.note: A show_automation flag and automation persistence exist; there is no full editing lane yet.

features.name: Arrangement markers
features.note: Loop markers are functional; the general marker lane is missing.

features.name: Clip fades
features.note: Fade handles are not exposed in the arranger.

features.name: Tempo / time-signature lane
features.note: Global tempo and signature exist; arrangement automation is not implemented.

features.name: Clip stretch handles on the timeline

areas.name: Transport & Sync
areas.bitwig_reference: Transport, tempo, musical time and synchronization (Bitwig Studio 5.1.7).

features.name: Master clock shared with the audio engine
Punch in/out
features.note: Flags are present, recording behaviour is not.

areas.name: Group Tracks & Routing
areas.bitwig_reference: Recursive group tracks, track types, monitoring and signal routing (Bitwig Studio 5.1.7).

features.name: Parent color rail and nesting indent
Send buses UI
features.note: The Track model carries sends; routing UI is partial.

features.name: Routing matrix UI
features.note: Destinations are modeled, the full matrix is not exposed.

areas.name: Time-stretching & Audio
areas.bitwig_reference: Audio playback, warping and time-stretching (Bitwig Studio 5.1.7).

features.name: Real-time streaming stretch
features.note: Stretch is precomputed into a buffer; the streaming path is partial.

features.name: Automatic warp to project tempo
features.note: Warp markers exist; automatic beat-grid warping is partial.

areas.name: Built-in Devices & FX
areas.bitwig_reference: All 118 native .bwdevice plug-ins shipped with Bitwig Studio 5.1.7 (instruments, audio FX, note FX, Grid and utilities).

features.name: Filter+
features.note: Hikaru exposes the base device; the extended Bitwig variant is partial.

features.name: Flanger+
features.note: Hikaru exposes the base device; the extended Bitwig variant is partial.

features.name: Phaser+
features.note: Hikaru exposes the base device; the extended Bitwig variant is partial.

areas.name: Modulators
areas.bitwig_reference: All 43 native .bwmodulator modules shipped with Bitwig Studio 5.1.7.

features.name: Classic LFO
features.note: OpenModulation covers a basic LFO; Bitwig's shape/polarity set is partial.

areas.name: Grid Devices
areas.bitwig_reference: 218 native Grid modules (.bwmodule) from Bitwig Studio 5.1.7 (Poly Grid / FX Grid / Note Grid).

areas.name: Mixer & I/O
areas.bitwig_reference: Mixer channel strips, master section, routing and audio device I/O (Bitwig Studio 5.1.7).

areas.name: Browser & Files
areas.bitwig_reference: Pop-up browser, content filters, file explorer, presets and project files (Bitwig Studio 5.1.7).

areas.name: MIDI & Controllers
areas.bitwig_reference: MIDI editing, hardware controllers, MIDI learn, MPE and sync (Bitwig Studio 5.1.7).

features.name: MIDI clip scheduling in the audio engine
Drum-pad mode in the piano roll

areas.name: UI & Workflow
areas.bitwig_reference: Look, layout, panels, menus and workflow of Bitwig Studio 5.1.7.

areas.name: Build & Platform
areas.bitwig_reference: Platform support, packaging and release engineering expected from a Bitwig Studio 5.1.7 replacement.
